en: 'Solomon's Nightmare' Rick Dom, controlled by Captain Annabelle Gato, appears in HGUC! !
From "Mobile Suit Gundam 0083 STARDUST MEMORY", piloted by Annabelle Gato, the ace pilot of the Zeon remnants.
Commercialize Rick Dom with HGUC!
● Reproduce the characteristic color with molding color and seal.
● The heat saber comes in normal yellow and light blue with the image of being on fire.
●In addition to the beam bazooka, weapons and wrist parts are included to enjoy reproducing various scenes.
Attached weapons: beam bazooka, heat saber, etc.
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
